hero_sub: Oasis Women Center is opening a transitional home for women who have finished a recovery program. Every line of the house has a price. Every gift draws it in.

phases.title: The drawing
phases.body: The four pillars are set, the board is seated, and the house is planned down to the kitchen table.

phases.title: The lease or the purchase
phases.body: A four-bedroom home in Denton County, secured by lease or by purchase.

phases.title: The rooms made ready
phases.body: Beds, comforters, a lamp and a Bible on every nightstand, and a table big enough for everyone.

phases.title: The door that locks
phases.body: Eight women, twelve to twenty-four months each, in a home that is theirs while they rebuild.

lines_note: Gifts exceeding this item's goal will support the remaining costs of establishing and opening the Oasis Women Center home.

lines.title: Program Development & Infrastructure
lines.price_note: An estimate. The final figure waits on a quote.
lines.body: A safe home provides shelter, but a well-designed program provides the foundation for lasting transformation. At Oasis Women Center, we believe women transitioning from substance-use recovery need more than a place to live. They need access to the tools, resources, and support systems that will help them build sustainable, independent lives.
more: Before we open our doors, we are investing in the development of a structured, intentional program designed around four essential pillars: Housing, Financial Literacy & Education, Transportation, and Mental Health Resources.

Your generosity will help fund community needs assessments, program evaluations, logic models, measurable outcomes, program policies, and evaluation tools that will guide how we deliver services and measure our impact.

We want to do more than provide temporary assistance. We want to build a program that identifies barriers, addresses individual needs, tracks progress, and equips women with the skills and support needed to move toward independence. Your gift helps turn our vision into a well-designed program with a clear path to measurable impact.
lines.photo_alt: An open notebook with handwritten notes, a pen, and a calculator on a wooden table beside a mug.

lines.title: Sponsor a bedroom
lines.subtitle: Give her a place to call her own
lines.price_note: Per bedroom. The home has four.
lines.body: Every woman deserves a comfortable place to rest, recharge, and begin again. Your gift helps furnish a bedroom with a bed, mattress, dresser, bedding, and personal essentials. Your gift provides more than furniture. It helps create a personal space where a woman can begin rebuilding her life.
lines.after_note: Once all four bedrooms are sponsored, gifts to this line go toward furnishing the rest of the home.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a made twin bed beside a nightstand with a lit lamp and a Bible.
lines.photo_alt: A bedroom in bright morning light with a neatly made bed and a lamp and Bible on the nightstand.

lines.title: Furnish the Oasis Home
lines.subtitle: Turn a House Into a Home
lines.price_note: The shared living spaces and the kitchen.
lines.body: A house becomes a home through the little things that make people feel safe, welcomed, and cared for. Your generosity will help create comfortable shared living spaces, equip the kitchen, and provide the everyday essentials women need as they transition toward independent living. Help us transform an empty house into a place filled with comfort, dignity, healing, and hope.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a wooden kitchen table with two chairs and two mugs.
lines.photo_alt: A sofa with a sage-green throw, a wooden armchair, and a coffee table with a Bible and a mug beside a sunlit window.

lines.title: Purchase Preparation
lines.body: Covers preliminary property inspections, appraisal, closing costs, due diligence, and professional consultations to help ensure the property is appropriate for transitional housing.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a curbside mailbox with flowers at its base.
lines.photo_alt: A small sage-green house with a covered front porch, in early morning light.

lines.title: Transportation & Independence
lines.subtitle: A ride to work
lines.price_note: For all eight residents, for the first year.
lines.body: Bus passes, ride share vouchers, and gas cards, so work, court, medical appointments, and childcare stay within reach.
lines.drawing_alt: A pencil and watercolor drawing of a bus stop sign and a bench under a small tree.
lines.photo_alt: A quiet tree-lined road at sunrise, empty and bright.

lines.title: Social Worker
lines.subtitle: Someone in Her Corner
lines.price_note: A part-time social worker, 20 hours a week, for one year.
lines.body: Your generosity helps provide women with individualized licensed support, guidance, and connections to the resources they need to move beyond recovery and toward sustainable independence. Your gift helps ensure no woman has to navigate her next chapter alone.
lines.photo_alt: Two mugs and a small vase on a wooden kitchen table by a window.
